text_block_list.text:
Most Umamusume aim to win their races.
However, Calstone Light O...
choice_data_list: Is top speed more important to you?
Is top speed more important to you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Purely because—
I want to run faster than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Having been born an Umamusume,
I want to dash at the fastest speed in the
world.
I want to prove it on the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That—and that alone—is my dream.
My ultimate summit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go quite that far.
However,
I have no intention of sacrificing speed
just to pick up a win.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...I have many weaknesses,
such as cornering.
Yet the brilliance of top speed obliterates
them all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I simply—want to become light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Just like my mother—
to leave behind an unfading trail of
radiance.

text_block_list.name: Young Light O
text_block_list.text:
Foton reeseerch?
Whoa, your paper got super famous, Mama!

text_block_list.name: Light O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It did.
Though you know,
this research doesn't make a single penny.

text_block_list.name: Young Light O
text_block_list.text:
I seeee. So it was a waste of work.
Buuut~

text_block_list.name: Young Light O
text_block_list.text:
I really love the sparkly light Mama
made~!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —A truly touching mother-daughter episode.
choice_data_list: Was it?! Sounded pretty harsh to m...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, a question for you.
If I team up with you—
can we aim for top speed?

Of that,
there was no doubt.
I could teach her racecraft,
while simultaneously raising her raw running
speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The contract is sealed.
Present the three-year plan.
What is the final objective?
Where is the victory hot spring trip?
choice_data_list: Too fast, too fast, too fast...

text_block_list.text:
She formed a contract all on her own and
almost sprinted straight through three
years.
This is a serious matter,
so I can't just accept lightly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Time's up. Is it a go? Now,
for the three-year...
choice_data_list: Still too fast! Give me a few days!

text_block_list.text:
She was hopelessly impatient and totally
inflexible.
I somehow managed to get her to wait three
days,
and we parted ways for the afternoon.

Watching the Umamusume sprinting across the
training grounds,
I lost myself in thought.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose... I won't lose...!
Today I'll be the first across that finish
line!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Heh, stop me if you can!
Witness my Holy Sword shine upon the precipice
of victory and defeat!

Everyone aims for victory without
hesitation.
That sight is beautiful,
and rightfully true.

Calstone Light O aiming for top speed is
even more captivating.
Yet whether it's 'right' is another
question...

An almost excessively pure romantic dream.
Precisely because of that purity,
no one else strives for it. Even so...

I want to see it...
I want to see Calstone Light O grow faster
and dash at hypersonic speeds more than anyone.
But at the same time...

Is it right to partner with an Umamusume
who doesn't hold victory supreme?
And if I do, how should I guide her?
Hmph, top speed, you say?

Quite an amusing notion.
A concept that thoroughly piques my
curiosity.

Glancing beside me,
I saw an Umamusume standing there with a
suspicious gleam in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon.
Just a passing scientist who's set up shop
in a quiet corner of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Won't you tell me more?
About this "challenge of top speed" of yours,
that is.
